title: Trash Plugin - ElMarcels
description: A simple /trash plugin. A plugin by ElMarcels
body:
A simple /trash plugin.
The /trash plugin, opens a temporary inventory with the command /trash, and when you close this inventory, all items dropped in, destroys.
This is a plugin created by ElMarcels
You can support the plugin donating in https://www.paypal.com/paypalme/ElMarcels

## DEPENDENCIES
- TrashPlugin requires the **LuckPerms (OPTIONAL)**, **Vault** & **PlaceholderAPI (OPTIONAL)** plugins.

## 🐛 How to Report Issues
